name: Din Djarin's N-1 starfighter
description: Din Djarin's N-1 starfighter, also known as The Mandalorian's N-1 starfighter, was a modified N-1 starfighter owned by Din Djarin following the destruction of the Razor Crest. Djarin and the mechanic Peli Motto worked together to build the N-1 starfighter as a replacement.

data.name: Din Djarin's N-1 starfighter
data.manufacturer: Theed Palace Space Vessel Engineering Corps
armament: Fire-linked proton torpedo launcher (2) (one torpedo launch tube under nose)
